CertificateType.description_zh:
证书类型。取值：

free：免费证书。
cas：云盾证书。
upload：自定义上传

CommonName.description_en: The primary domain name bound to the certificate

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The user-defined identifier, which serves as a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Id.description_en: The data source ID to which the certificate order belongs

KeyExportable.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate can be used. Valid values:

true: Can be used.
false: Cannot be used
KeyExportable.description_zh:
是否可以使用该证书。取值：

true：可以使用。
false：不可以使用

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the company or organization to which the user who purchased the certificate belongs
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织名称

Status.description_en:
The certificate status. Valid values:

ISSUE: Normal.
REVOKE: Revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。取值：

ISSUE：正常。
REVOKE：已吊销

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个

ShowSize.description_en: The total size of the certificate. Unit: bytes
ShowSize.description_zh: 证书的总大小。单位：字节
